title: Toddler Sandy Lee on Lawn, 1950s Galesburg B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring an 18-month-old toddler named Sandy Lee wearing a light-colored frilly dress and booties. She is standing happily in the grassy yard outside her grandmother's house in Galesburg, which features ashlar stone siding and trimmed shrubbery. Handwritten annotations on the front border record her name, age, and location.
